_comment: Copy to weekly-directives.json. Ignored unless week_of equals the Monday of the week being generated. Omit a segment to leave it fully autonomous; 'skip' plans zero emails for it. 'deadlines' is the ONLY way (besides a live store discount with an end date) to unlock urgency/countdown copy.
retail: skip — no retail sends this week.
wholesale: Feature the new seasonal batch. Angle for distributors: fresh availability, selection, volume tiers. No discount codes — full price, product-led. Do not reuse the angle or subject skeleton from last month's launch email.
international: Feature the new seasonal batch, international-eligible lines only. Quote-only — do NOT state any prices. Angle: selection, export-scale volume, request a quote / sample.
notes: Week of Oct 19 is wholesale + international only.
